name: znetwork_set_fatal_disconnect_callback
description: zNetwork::SetFatalDisconnectCallback stores the fatal disconnect callback used by DirectPlay system-message handling.
known_limits: Functional smoke verifies that the fastcall setter stores a non-null callback pointer and can clear it back to null. tier S comparison is deferred to the zNetwork DirectPlay/session runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x489f90 stores ECX directly into g_zNetwork_FatalDisconnectCallback and returns.
The callback is consumed by zNetwork_DPlay::PumpIncomingMessages during fatal DirectPlay system-message handling.
